documents.title: Guidelines for Use of AI at UF
documents.summary: A long university-wide framework with dos and don'ts, instructor and student guidance, three suggested AI levels, and research and HR sections. It leans pro-AI but leaves course rules to instructors.
documents.stance_why: The guidelines present three syllabus levels (AI-Permitted, Some AI, No AI) as 'general approaches' and tell instructors to 'include clear statements in your syllabus', so the university sets no default and delegates the choice to instructors.

units.why: The page opens with a statement of its own scope, 'a university-wide framework for using AI responsibly in teaching, learning, research, and HR', which is an institution-level framework and preamble (P56), addressed to all and informational.
units.anchor: a university-wide framework for using AI responsibly in teaching, learning, research, and HR

units.why: 'Created with help from' a named group records how the guidelines were made; this is process information (P84), not a rule.

units.anchor: Version 2: 2026.
